claims.claim: B's factory has new type computer products
claims.attribute: B's factory possesses new type computer products

evidence.quote: our factory and have a look at the new type computer products

claims.adjudication_reason: Second-review support: Turn 3 states 'visit our factory and have a look at the new type computer products.' The definite possessive 'our factory' establishes B's association with the factory, and the definite description 'the new type computer products' in the context of visiting that factory to look at them presupposes such products exist at the factory. The initial review's objection that 'and' separates the activities is weak: the natural reading of visiting a factory to look at products is that the products are at the factory. The existence of the products is a presupposition of the definite description.
